{{Quote|Wherever we are, we're a long way from home. I've never seen anything like ''that'' from any of the Outer Rim worlds I've been to.|Jorj Car'das|<ref name="Outbound">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Jorj.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jorj Car'das took note of the star cluster after the ''Bargain Hunter''{{'s}} arrival in the Unknown Regions.]]
A small but brilliant globular '''star cluster''' was visible from a [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two)|star system]] that was situated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], around 250 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from that territory's border with [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Outbound" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'' arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] after a blind [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the relatively inexperienced [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] [[Jorj Car'das]] noted that he had not seen any similar [[Star cluster/Legends|star clusters]] from the Outer Rim [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] he had visited. When the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dubrak Qennto]], returned to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] after shutting down the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] malfunctioning [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], he also noted the cluster, characterizing it as "nice."<ref name="Outbound" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star cluster appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" />
